ei.subject: 영어Ⅰ
ei.title: The Power of Data in Sports

questions.passage: Sabermetrics was created in the late 1970s. It tries to use large amounts of information to discover patterns, trends, and insights <u>ⓐ that</u> are difficult to find with traditional ways of studying statistics. Normally, coaches and managers prefer players <u>ⓑ who</u> can hit the ball hard and far, for such players tend to hit more home runs and extra-base hits. Sabermetrics suggests that players' offensive skills can be better <u>ⓒ measuring</u> by the frequency with which they safely reach base. It does not matter <u>ⓓ whether</u> this is achieved through hits, walks, or hits by pitch. Sabermetrics <u>ⓔ had not been</u> widely used until the Athletics adopted it in 2002.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.ref: [원문] players' offensive skills can be better measuring → measured [해석] 선수들의 공격 능력은 그들이 안전하게 출루하는 빈도에 의해 더 잘 측정될 수 있다. 주어 skills는 측정을 '당하는' 대상이므로 수동태(be measured)가 와야 합니다.
det.correct:
ⓐ that: 관계대명사 주격, 선행사 patterns, trends, and insights(사물·복수) → that + are 수일치 적절 ✅
ⓑ who: 관계대명사 주격, 선행사 players(사람·복수) → who can hit 적절 ✅
ⓒ measuring: 조동사 can + be + 과거분사 → be better measured가 되어야 수동태 완성. measuring은 능동(현재분사)이므로 어법 오류 ❌
ⓓ whether: '~인지 아닌지' 명사절 접속사, matter의 주어절로 적절 ✅
ⓔ had not been: 과거완료 수동 — 2002년 이전까지 사용되지 않았음. until과 함께 과거완료 적절 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 수동태 공식: 주어 + be + p.p. (+ by 행위자). can be measured (O) / can be measuring (X). 조동사 뒤: 조동사 + be + p.p. 비교: 능동 → They can measure skills / 수동 → Skills can be measured.

questions.passage: The new team included a physicist from Cambridge, a nuclear scientist from Harvard, and a former chess champion. What they had in common (A) [was / were] significant expertise in data. The team started to apply data analysis in key areas of club management, (B) [included / including] player recruitment, injury prevention, and strategy during the game. The data team was praised for its efforts when the Liverpool Football Club won the league championship for the first time (C) [in / for] 30 years in 2020.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 그들이 공통적으로 가진 것은 데이터에 대한 상당한 전문 지식이었다. 선수 영입, 부상 방지, 경기 중 전략을 포함하여 핵심 분야에 적용했다. 30년 만에 처음으로 리그 우승을 차지했다.
det.correct:
(A) was: What절(관계대명사 what) 주어 → 단수 취급, 보어 expertise(불가산) → was ✅ / were ❌
(B) including: 현재분사 전치사적 용법 '~을 포함하여' → including ✅ / included는 관계절 필요 ❌
(C) in: 'for the first time in + 기간' = ~만에 처음으로 → in ✅ / for는 '~동안'으로 문맥 부적합 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 What절 주어 → 단수 동사: What matters is ~. / 'for the first time in + 기간' = ~만에 처음. including(~을 포함하여) vs included(포함했다 → 동사로 쓰려면 주절 필요).

ch: (A) was — (B) included — (C) in
(A) was — (B) including — (C) in
(A) were — (B) including — (C) for
(A) was — (B) including — (C) for
(A) were — (B) included — (C) in

questions.passage: The team developed a system to monitor players' heart rates by using advanced visual computing technology <u>ⓐ to convert</u> facial color variations into heart rates. This data was used for psychological training <u>ⓑ to help</u> players maintain stable heart rates during crucial moments. The team also created an AI coach <u>ⓒ that</u> helped adjust shooting form. The team managers requested that the AI coach <u>ⓓ edits</u> training videos of the players to assist with practical analysis.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.ref: [원문] requested that the AI coach edits → edit [해석] 팀 관리자들은 AI 코치가 훈련 영상을 편집할 것을 요청했다. request that + S + (should) + 동사원형: 당위·요구 동사 뒤 that절에서는 동사원형을 씁니다.
det.correct:
ⓐ to convert: 목적의 to부정사(부사적 용법), '변환하기 위해' → 적절 ✅
ⓑ to help: to부정사(목적), '돕기 위해' → 적절 ✅
ⓒ that: 관계대명사 주격, 선행사 AI coach → that helped 적절 ✅
ⓓ edits: request that + S + (should) 동사원형 → edits(3인칭 단수 현재)는 오류 ❌ → edit이 정답
det.tip: 🔑 요구·제안·명령 동사 + that + S + (should) + 동사원형: request / demand / suggest / insist / recommend 등. 예) He suggested that she go (O) / goes (X). 이를 가정법 현재(subjunctive mood)라 합니다.

questions.passage: The Oakland Athletics were a small team with (A) [limited / unlimited] funds, which made it difficult for them to attract elite players. With sabermetrics, the Athletics were able to identify (B) [underrated / overrated] players with significant contributions to winning and built a strong team on a small budget. The success of the Athletics (C) [prompted / prevented] other teams to quickly adopt sabermetrics.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 자금이 (A) 제한된 소규모 팀 → 세이버메트릭스로 (B) 저평가된 선수 발굴 → 성공이 다른 팀의 도입을 (C) 촉진
det.correct:
(A) limited(제한된): 소규모 팀 + 엘리트 영입 어려움 → limited ✅ / unlimited ❌
(B) underrated(저평가된): 적은 예산 + 기여도 높은 선수 → underrated ✅ / overrated ❌
(C) prompted(촉진했다): 성공 → 다른 팀도 도입 → prompted ✅ / prevented ❌
det.tip: 🔑 limited ≈ restricted ↔ unlimited. underrated ≈ undervalued ↔ overrated. prompted ≈ encouraged, triggered ↔ prevented.

ch: (A) limited — (B) underrated — (C) prompted
(A) unlimited — (B) underrated — (C) prompted
(A) limited — (B) overrated — (C) prevented
(A) limited — (B) underrated — (C) prevented
(A) unlimited — (B) overrated — (C) prompted

questions.passage: Following its debut at the Winter Olympic Games of 2014, the team recognized the need to ① <u>enhance</u> its sweeping technique. Sweeping melts the ice and makes the stone move faster. If too much ice melts, however, the stone moves too fast and ② <u>misses</u> the target. On the other hand, if not enough ice melts, the stone stops before reaching the target. The amount of ice melting depends on the sweeping speed and pressure. Applying too much pressure ③ <u>accelerates</u> the sweeping speed, and focusing only on speed makes it hard to transfer enough force to the broom.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.ref: [원문] Applying too much pressure slows down the sweeping speed [해석] 너무 많은 압력을 가하면 스위핑 속도가 느려진다. accelerates(가속하다)는 정반대 의미.
det.correct:
① enhance(향상시키다): 스위핑 기술 향상 필요 → 적절 ✅
② misses(빗나가다): 돌이 과녁을 빗나감 → 적절 ✅
③ accelerates(가속하다): 원문 slows down → 반대 의미 ❌ → slows down이 적절
④ depends(달려있다): 스위핑 속도와 압력에 달려있다 → 적절 ✅
⑤ transfer(전달하다): 충분한 힘을 전달하기 어렵다 → 적절 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 accelerate ≈ speed up ↔ slow down, decelerate. 문맥: 압력 과다 → 속도 감소 / 속도만 집중 → 힘 전달 부족. 반대 관계 주목!

ch: ① enhance
② misses
③ accelerates
④ depends
⑤ transfer

questions.passage: There are still limitations to what data analysis can ① <u>capture</u> in games. Factors such as team chemistry, which is related to how well people get along, will likely remain difficult to ② <u>measure</u>. Similarly, ③ <u>predicting</u> player performance in a match cannot be entirely ④ <u>inaccurate</u> as players are humans and not machines. Still, sports analytics is undeniably ⑤ <u>elevating</u> the level of play across various sports.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.ref: [원문] cannot be entirely accurate [해석] 완전히 정확할 수는 없다. inaccurate 사용 시 이중부정 → 의미 왜곡.
det.correct:
① capture(포착하다): 데이터 분석이 포착할 수 있는 것의 한계 → 적절 ✅
② measure(측정하다): 팀 화학 측정 어려움 → 적절 ✅
③ predicting(예측하는 것): 동명사 주어 → 적절 ✅
④ inaccurate(부정확한): 원문 accurate → cannot be entirely accurate(완전히 정확할 수 없다). inaccurate 시 이중부정 ❌
⑤ elevating(향상시키는): 경기 수준 향상 → 적절 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 accurate(정확한) ↔ inaccurate(부정확한). 이중부정 함정: cannot be inaccurate = 부정확할 수 없다 = 정확하다 → 한계 강조 문맥과 모순.

ch: ① capture
② measure
③ predicting
④ inaccurate
⑤ elevating

questions.passage: When the Oakland Athletics, a Major League Baseball team, won 20 games in a row in 2002, the professional sports industry was shocked. The Oakland Athletics were a small team with limited funds, which made it difficult for them to attract elite players. How did they do it? The key to their success was adopting sabermetrics, a statistical model used for making decisions in baseball. With sabermetrics, the Athletics were able to identify underrated players with significant contributions to winning and built a strong team on a small budget. The success of the Athletics prompted other teams to quickly adopt sabermetrics, sparking a movement to utilize data not only in baseball but also in other sports.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 오클랜드 애슬레틱스가 세이버메트릭스를 도입하여 제한된 예산으로도 강팀을 구축한 사례. 이 성공이 다른 스포츠로 데이터 활용이 확산되는 계기. 핵심: 데이터 분석의 스포츠 전략 변화 역할.
det.correct:
① MLB 역사: 야구 역사가 아닌 데이터 활용 사례 ❌
② 데이터 분석의 스포츠 전략 변화 역할: 핵심 주제와 정확히 일치 ✅
③ 소규모 팀의 경쟁 불가: 오히려 데이터로 성공한 이야기 ❌
④ 기술의 부정적 효과: 긍정적 효과 중심 ❌
⑤ 엘리트 선수 영입 방법: 저평가 선수 발굴이 요점 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 주제 파악: 반복 키워드(sabermetrics, data, statistical model) + 글의 방향(성공 → 확산) → 데이터 분석의 역할.

ch: the history and origin of Major League Baseball
the role of data analytics in transforming sports strategy
reasons why small teams cannot compete with larger ones
the negative effects of technology on traditional sports
how elite players are recruited in professional baseball

questions.passage: In soccer, the Liverpool Football Club of the English Premier League is similar to the Oakland Athletics in baseball. The new team included a physicist from Cambridge, a nuclear scientist from Harvard, and a former chess champion. The team started to apply data analysis in key areas of club management, including player recruitment, injury prevention, and strategy during the game. The data team was praised for its efforts when the Liverpool Football Club won the league championship for the first time in 30 years in 2020.
questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 리버풀 FC가 과학자들로 구성된 데이터 팀을 만들어 선수 영입, 부상 방지, 전략에 분석을 적용하고 30년 만에 우승한 이야기. 핵심: 과학/데이터 기반 승리.
det.correct:
① 축구 인기: 주제 아님 ❌
② 데이터 기반 승리: 데이터·과학으로 우승 → 정답 ✅
③ 팀 화학: 본 지문에서 미언급 ❌
④ 유명 과학자들: 과학자가 아닌 데이터 활용이 핵심 ❌
⑤ 리버풀 역사: 30년 역사가 아닌 데이터 성공 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 제목 = 주제 + 흥미 요소. '데이터/과학' + '우승' 두 키워드가 결합된 ②가 가장 포괄적.

ch: Why Soccer Is the Most Popular Sport in Europe
Data-Driven Victory: How Liverpool Used Science to Win
The Importance of Team Chemistry in Soccer
Famous Scientists Who Changed the Sports Industry
Liverpool's Long History of League Championships

questions.passage: There are still limitations to what data analysis can capture in games. Factors such as team chemistry, which is related to how well people get along, will likely remain difficult to measure. Similarly, predicting player performance in a match cannot be entirely accurate as players are humans and not machines. Still, sports analytics is undeniably elevating the level of play across various sports, and fans are enjoying this development.
questions.stem: 위 글이 시사하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 데이터 분석의 한계(팀 화학, 완전한 예측 불가) + 그럼에도 불구하고 가치 있음(경기 수준 향상, 팬들의 즐거움). 핵심 시사점: 한계는 있지만 가치가 있다.
det.correct:
① completely replaced coaches: 극단적 표현, 코치 대체 언급 없음 ❌
② valuable despite limitations: 한계에도 불구하고 가치 있다는 논조와 일치 ✅
③ perfect accuracy: cannot be entirely accurate 명시 ❌
④ most important factor: 가장 중요하다고 하지 않음 ❌
⑤ fans dislike: fans are enjoying → 정반대 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 Still/Nevertheless 뒤 = 필자의 최종 입장. 극단적 표현(completely, perfectly, most) 포함 선지는 대부분 오답.

ch: Data analysis has completely replaced the role of coaches in sports.
Sports analytics is valuable despite its inability to measure every factor in games.
Player performance can now be predicted with perfect accuracy through data.
Team chemistry is the most important factor for winning championships.
Fans generally dislike the influence of data analytics on sports.

questions.passage: Sabermetrics was created in the late 1970s. It tries to use large amounts of information to discover patterns, trends, and insights that are difficult to find with traditional ways of studying statistics. Sabermetrics had not been widely used until the Athletics adopted it in 2002. With sabermetrics, the Athletics were able to identify underrated players with significant contributions to winning and built a strong team on a small budget.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 세이버메트릭스: 1970년대 후반 창시, 2002년 전까지 널리 사용되지 않음, 저평가된 선수 발굴에 활용.
det.correct:
① early 1990s: 원문 late 1970s → 시기 불일치 ❌
② widely used before 2002: had not been widely used until 2002 → 불일치 ❌
③ unlimited funds: 원문 limited funds ❌
④ find underrated players: identify underrated players와 일치 ✅
⑤ only home runs: 출루율 중시 → 불일치 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 일치 문제: 숫자·시기·정도 대조. late ↔ early, limited ↔ unlimited 등 미세한 변형에 주의.

ch: Sabermetrics was created in the early 1990s.
Sabermetrics was widely used before 2002.

questions.passage: The team analyzed large amounts of data to recruit players who fit the team's style of play. In training, they collected data on players' movement patterns, heart rates, and vital signs by using GPS trackers and sensors to prevent injuries. During games, they used live data to make tactical decisions such as substitutions and formations. The data team was praised for its efforts when the Liverpool Football Club won the league championship for the first time in 30 years in 2020.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 원문: for the first time in 30 years. 선지 ④는 20년으로 숫자가 다름(30 → 20).
det.correct:
① recruit suitable players: 원문 일치 ✅
② GPS trackers during training: 원문 일치 ✅
③ live data for tactical decisions: 원문 일치 ✅
④ first time in 20 years: 원문 30 years → 불일치 ❌ → 정답
⑤ movement patterns and heart rates: 원문 일치 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 불일치 문제: 숫자 변형이 가장 흔한 함정. 30 → 20 등 수치를 정확히 대조하세요.

ch: The team analyzed data to recruit suitable players.

questions.passage: Sabermetrics suggests that players' offensive skills can be better measured by the frequency with which they safely reach base. It does not matter whether this is achieved through hits, walks, or hits by pitch. In other words, sabermetrics places greater value on __________ rather than sheer power at the plate.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 세이버메트릭스는 안전하게 출루하는 빈도로 공격력을 평가. 안타, 볼넷, 몸에 맞는 공 등 방법 무관. 즉, 타석의 순수한 파워보다 꾸준한 출루에 가치를 둔다.
det.correct:
① salary/reputation: 언급 없음 ❌
② home runs: 전통적 평가 방식 → 세이버메트릭스의 대안적 관점과 반대 ❌
③ getting on base consistently: safely reach base = 꾸준한 출루 ✅
④ swing speed: 언급 없음 ❌
⑤ coaching experience: 무관 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 In other words(즉) 뒤 = 앞 내용의 환언. safely reach base → getting on base consistently. rather than 구조에서 대비 개념 파악.

questions.passage: To identify the most effective technique, the Korean team designed a sweeping measurement device. The device consisted of infrared cameras and sensors attached to the players' bodies, shoes, and brooms. Through the device and motion-capture screens, foot pressure values and other data were obtained for analysis. After monitoring changes in the temperature of the ice surface, the team concluded that __________.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 적외선 카메라와 센서로 데이터 수집·분석 후, 얼음 온도 변화 모니터링 → 스위핑에는 힘보다 속도가 더 경제적이라는 결론.
det.correct:
① traditional methods more effective: 데이터 분석으로 새 결론 도출 → 전통 방식 우위 아님 ❌
② speed more economical than strength: 원문 결론과 일치 ✅
③ maximum pressure at all times: 압력 과다 시 속도 감소 → 부적절 ❌
④ cameras too expensive: 비용 미언급 ❌
⑤ temperature no effect: 온도 모니터링 = 영향 있음 전제 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 concluded that ~ = 연구 결론. speed vs strength/pressure 대비 구조 파악. 앞 문맥(측정 → 데이터 → 결론)의 논리 흐름 따라가기.

questions.passage:
[주어진 글] The Korean women's archery team had dominated the sport for decades. However, the team turned to sports analytics to maintain its edge over its rivals in preparation for the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

(A) Players and coaches used the edited videos to analyze the players' usual habits or weaknesses. The active use of data analysis handed them their ninth Olympic gold medal in a row in Tokyo.

(B) The team developed a system to monitor players' heart rates by using advanced visual computing technology to convert facial color variations into heart rates. This data was used for psychological training.

(C) The team also created an AI coach that helped adjust shooting form. The team managers requested that the AI coach edit training videos of the players to assist with practical analysis.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 주어진 글(분석 도입) → (B) 심박수 모니터링 시스템 개발 → (C) AI 코치 개발 + 영상 편집 요청 → (A) 편집된 영상으로 분석 + 9연속 금메달
det.correct:
(B) 먼저: turned to sports analytics에 이어 구체적 기술(심박수 시스템) 소개
(C) 다음: also created(추가 기술) → AI 코치 + 영상 편집 요청
(A) 마지막: the edited videos(C에서 편집 요청 → A에서 활용) + 결과(금메달)
따라서 (B)-(C)-(A) ✅
det.tip: 🔑 순서배열: ① 지시어 추적: the edited videos(A) ← edit training videos(C). ② also(C)는 병렬 추가. ③ 논리: 시스템 개발(B) → 추가 기술(C) → 결과(A).
